# Plyr 3.8.4

Official package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/plyr/v/3.8.4
Documentation: https://github.com/sampotts/plyr

Runtime, stylesheet, sprite, and license files were copied without modification from the published package:
dist/plyr.min.mjs (named plyr.mjs), dist/plyr.css, dist/plyr.svg,
src/js/plyr.d.ts (named plyr.d.mts), and LICENSE.md.

The declaration file retains its default export; its conflicting CommonJS
export assignment and global namespace export were removed for the ESM bundle.

The local bundle avoids depending on a third-party player CDN during playback.
The package tarball's reported SHA-1 is 5f17bc077a5246d2e313cb74cde648149bc6b735.
